Harvard astronomer Avi Loeb talks with Joe Rogan for episode 2401. Loeb argues that some objects from deep space may be alien tech. His claims have split fellow scientists for years.

Loeb pushes back at claims that he staged a space object for fame. He notes the object is huge and can be seen with home scopes. The pair discuss odd visitors from beyond our solar system. They also weigh how science should treat bold claims. Listeners get a clear sense of why Loeb keeps looking up and asking for proof.
